entities.summary: Gerhard Christiaan Coenraad (Gerrit) Pels Rijcken was a career officer of the Royal Dutch Navy and a politician. As an officer, Pels Rijcken reached the rank of Vice-Admiral. He was Dutch Navy Minister from 1866 to 1868.
